params.name: user_id
params.description: The user_id of the user whose profile to retrieve.

params.name: comp_id
params.description: The computed property ID or recommendation ID to retrieve specific computed results for the user.

params.name: get_recs
params.description: When true, include personalized recommendations in the response.

params.name: rec_id
params.description: The recommendation model ID to retrieve specific recommendation results.

params.name: rec_type
params.description: The type of recommendation to retrieve.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of recommendation results to return.

items.docs: Retrieve the profile for a specific user including user properties, computed properties, cohort memberships, and personalized recommendations. The response includes all enriched data Amplitude has computed for the user.
